description:
*Donation of 13 Chairs to Vivek Vidyalay*

Project Date: 27th October 2026
Beneficiary Institution: Vivek Vidyalay
Number of *Chairs Donated: 13*
Approximate Project Cost: *₹60,000*
Donor: Rtn. Sandeep Jaiswal

Project Overview

As part of our commitment to supporting education and improving school infrastructure, *13 chairs were donated to Vivek Vidyalay on 27th October 2026.*

The chairs were generously sponsored by *Rtn. Sandeep Jaiswal*, with an approximate total value of ₹60,000.

Project Impact

This initiative will help enhance the seating facilities at the school, creating a more comfortable and functional environment for students and staff. The donation reflects the spirit of community service and the importance of supporting educational institutions through meaningful contributions.

Acknowledgement

We express our heartfelt gratitude to Rtn. Sandeep Jaiswal for his generous contribution towards this educational initiative.

*Together, we are building better learning spaces and brighter futures, one thoughtful contribution at a time*.

*President Rtn. Jyoti Dongre*
*Rotary Club of Mumbai Ghatkopar West*
*Rotary District 3141 | Regal Year 2026–27*
